name: Shenzhou
about: Shenzhou (1999-061A), a crewed vehicle (Shenzhou), launched 1999 Nov 19. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1999 Nov 20), held fixed
GCAT gives no site; the point stands in for the programme's usual landing or recovery area, from memory

events.why: GCAT gives the launch without an hour
